welcome.q: A prospect asks where our leads come from. What do you say?
options: Explain the exact channels we use
Our hybrid lead engine, and stop there
Tell them to ask your manager
welcome.correct: Our hybrid lead engine, and stop there
welcome.explanation: Lead source is confidential. Say 'our hybrid lead engine' and stop there.

welcome.q: your manager says 'let's go with plan A' for a campaign. Can you send it now?
options: Yes, choosing a plan is approval
Yes, if the draft passed QA
No, send a review copy and wait for an explicit 'send' naming that send
Only to half of the list
welcome.correct: No, send a review copy and wait for an explicit 'send' naming that send
welcome.explanation: Choosing a plan is not approval to send.

welcome.q: In the 3-3-3 program, Phase 2 (OBSERVED) means you lead 3 calls while your manager listens and scores.
welcome.explanation: Phase 1 is WITH the manager, Phase 2 OBSERVED, Phase 3 ALONE.

welcome.q: Which line may marketing texts be sent from?
options: Only the company's registered 10DLC texting line
welcome.correct: Only the company's registered 10DLC texting line
welcome.explanation: Texts go only from the registered 10DLC texting line; the other line is calls-only.

role-and-kpis.q: What is the weekly minimum of qualified booked appointments?
role-and-kpis.explanation: 4 is the floor, not the ceiling; the target is 6+.

role-and-kpis.q: How fast must a new lead get its first call during business hours?
An appointment counts even if it was not reconfirmed the day before, as long as it is in Zoho.
role-and-kpis.explanation: It must be confirmed, logged in Zoho, have a complete handoff and be reconfirmed the day before.

role-and-kpis.q: What is the '3 touches in 48 h' sequence?
options: Call, approved text from the registered texting line, then a second call + CRM email the next business day
role-and-kpis.correct: Call, approved text from the registered texting line, then a second call + CRM email the next business day
role-and-kpis.explanation: After that the lead goes stale and into the weekly revive cycle.

scrum-trello.q: What is the maximum number of cards per person or agent in Doing?
scrum-trello.explanation: Max 2 cards per person or agent in Doing.

scrum-trello.q: A card in Doing has shown no progress for 2 hours. What do you do?
options: Step in: ask, split it, or move it to Blocked with the reason
scrum-trello.correct: Step in: ask, split it, or move it to Blocked with the reason

scrum-trello.q: Someone says 'it's done'. Is that enough evidence to move the card to We Get Sh*t Done!?
scrum-trello.explanation: Evidence (link, screenshot, Zoho ID, log) and independent live verification are required.

scrum-trello.q: How long is the daily standup?

crm-process.q: How do you search for duplicate records?
options: By the last 10 digits of the phone number or by email
crm-process.correct: By the last 10 digits of the phone number or by email
crm-process.explanation: Never match by name; many people share a name.

crm-process.q: When may you send the post-call 'Great connecting…' template?
options: Only after a real conversation with that person
To leads with a high engagement score
crm-process.correct: Only after a real conversation with that person

crm-process.q: Zoho merges can be undone later if you merge the wrong records.
crm-process.explanation: Merges are irreversible; ask your manager if in doubt.

crm-process.q: A new lead's Day 0 email does not appear in the Emails tab after 5 minutes. What do you do?
options: Send the email manually from your inbox
Check the rule is active, the email and language fields, then tell your manager with the lead's name
crm-process.correct: Check the rule is active, the email and language fields, then tell your manager with the lead's name

qa-scorecard.q: A call scores 72 with no critical fail. Which band is it?
qa-scorecard.explanation: Good 85–100, Bad 60–84, Ugly under 60 or any critical fail.

qa-scorecard.q: Which of these is a critical fail (automatic Ugly)?
options: Using the prospect's name only twice
qa-scorecard.explanation: Critical fails: lead source, unauthorized price, ignoring STOP, lying, disrespect, booking without address/time.

qa-scorecard.q: Before a bulk SMS, you remove anyone texted from the registered texting line in the last how many days?
qa-scorecard.explanation: 14-day suppression, plus anyone who ever said STOP.

qa-scorecard.q: Ugly calls are escalated to your manager the same day.
qa-scorecard.explanation: Ugly calls carry compliance, brand or client risk.
